grammarNotes.u1: Korean uses the Hangul alphabet grouped into syllable blocks and follows Subject-Object-Verb (SOV) order. Polite speech ends in -요 (-yo) or the formal -습니다/-ㅂ니다 (-seumnida/-mnida), used in greetings and apologies.
grammarNotes.u2: Use topic markers 은/는 (eun/neun) and subject markers 이/가 (i/ga) depending on whether the preceding syllable ends in a consonant. Korean kinship terms distinguish gender and age (e.g., 오빠/형 for older brother).
grammarNotes.u3: Korean has two number systems: Native Korean (하나, 둘, 셋) for counting items and hours, and Sino-Korean (일, 이, 삼) for minutes, dates, and money. Counters like 잔 (cup) or 권 (book) follow native numbers.
grammarNotes.u4: Direct objects take the particle 을/를 (eul/reul). Polite requests at restaurants commonly use -(으)세요 (-euseyo) or -주세요 (-juseyo, 'please give me').
grammarNotes.u5: Korean adjectives conjugate like verbs at the end of a sentence (크다 -> 커요). Before a noun, adjectives take the modifier ending -(으)ㄴ (큰 도시, 'big city').
grammarNotes.u6: Use 에 (e) for destinations and static locations, 에서 (eseo) for places where actions occur, and (으)로 (euro/ro) for direction or means of transport (기차로, 'by train').
grammarNotes.u7: To express 'want to', attach -고 싶다 (-go sipda) to a verb stem. To ask 'can I...?', use -(으)ㄹ 수 있어요? (e.g., 카드로 결제할 수 있어요?).
grammarNotes.u8: Weather expressions often pair a noun with a specific verb: 비가 오다 ('rain comes'), 눈이 내리다 ('snow falls'), 바람이 불다 ('wind blows').
grammarNotes.u9: Describe physical pain with [body part] + 이/가 아프다 (머리가 아파요). Give polite advice or instructions with -(으)세요 or -아/어야 해요 ('should/must').
grammarNotes.u10: Express ongoing actions with -고 있다 (-go itda) and hobbies with -는 것을 좋아하다 ('like doing...'). Time expressions like 6시에 attach 에 directly to the hour.
grammarNotes.u11: State opinions using -다고 생각하다 ('think that...') or -(으)ㄴ 것 같다 ('seem/think that...'). Descriptive verbs express emotions directly (기쁘다, 슬프다, 걱정되다).
grammarNotes.u12: Form the past tense with -았/었어요 (-at/eosseoyo) and future plans with -(으)ㄹ 거예요 (-eul geoyeyo). Modifiers -(으)ㄴ (past) and -는 (present) turn verbs into rich noun phrases.
grammarNotes.u13: Tech vocabulary blends Sino-Korean compounds (개인정보, 검색) with adapted loanwords (컴퓨터, 인터넷, 다운로드). Nominalize verbs with -기 or -는 것 to use them as subjects.
grammarNotes.u14: Cultural discourse frequently uses the honorific suffix -(으)시- when speaking of elders or respected figures, and passive -되다/-아/어지다 for traditions passed down over generations.
grammarNotes.u15: Connect clauses cleanly with -아서/어서 (because), -지만 / -(으)ㄴ데 (although/however), -(으)면 (if), and -는 대신에 (instead of). Conjunctive adverbs like 그러나 and 따라서 link formal sentences.
grammarNotes.u16: Workplace and business Korean favors the deferential 합쇼체 (-습니다/-ㅂ니다) and concise Sino-Korean compounds (전략, 예산, 협상, 합의) paired with 하다 or 되다.
grammarNotes.u17: Scientific writing uses objective, impersonal phrasing with -다/-ㄴ다 or -습니다, passive forms (-되다, 밝혀지다), and evidential connectors like -에 기반하다 ('be based on').
grammarNotes.u18: Sustainability and policy prose relies on compound noun phrases and modal expressions of necessity: -아야 한다 ('must'), -도록 ('so that'), and -을/를 통해 ('through').
grammarNotes.u19: Civic and legal discourse employs formal Sino-Korean roots (헌법, 민주주의, 투명성) and formal postpositions like -에 따라 ('according to') and -을/를 바탕으로 ('grounded in').
grammarNotes.u20: Structure persuasive arguments using contrastive markers (그럼에도 불구하고, 반면에), clarifying verbs (명확히 하다, 강조하다), and nominalized clauses ending in -다는 점 ('the point that...').
grammarNotes.u21: Literary Korean uses evocative modifiers, sensory verbs, and refined Sino-Korean aesthetic terms (은유, 상징성, 여운, 숭고하다) to convey layered emotional depth.
grammarNotes.u22: Philosophical and psychological writing contrasts abstract concepts with -는 반면 ('whereas'), -을/를 통해 ('through'), and reflective nominal forms ending in -(으)ㅁ.
grammarNotes.u23: Korean idioms include traditional proverbs (속담, e.g., 시간이 약이다), four-character Sino-Korean idioms (사자성어, e.g., 전화위복), and vivid figurative expressions (식은 죽 먹기).
grammarNotes.u24: Diplomatic, legal, and academic Korean uses elevated formal register: -에도 불구하고 ('notwithstanding'), -에 비추어 볼 때 ('in light of'), and courteous deferential framing (실례지만).
grammarNotes.u25: C2 mastery combines rhetorical precision, idiomatic cohesion (의심의 여지 없이, 마찬가지로, 종합해 보면), and effortless switching between conversational warmth and formal gravitas.

c356.xr: Chogiui jiyeonedo bulguhago geu gyoryangeun anjeonhage gaetongdoeeosseumnida.

c357.x: 예산이 확대되었고, 결과적으로 농촌 진료소가 늘어났습니다.
c357.xr: Yesani hwakdaedoeeotgo, gyeolgwajeogeuro nongchon jillyosoga neureonasseumnida.

c358.x: 더 나아가 공공 데이터 개방은 독립 연구자들에게 큰 도움이 됩니다.
c358.xr: Deo naaga gonggong deiteo gaebangeun dongnip yeongujadeurege keun doumi doemnida.

c359.x: 새로운 증거에 비추어 볼 때 지침을 개정했습니다.
c359.xr: Saeroun jeunggeoe bichueo bol ttae jichimeul gaejeonghaesseumnida.

c360.x: 외람되오나 대안적인 접근 방식을 제안드리고자 합니다.
c360.xr: Oeramdoeona daeanjeogin jeopgeun bangsigeul jeandeurigoja hamnida.

c361.x: 그녀는 복잡한 개념도 막힘없이 명료하게 표현합니다.
c361.xr: Geunyeoneun bokjapan gaenyeomdo makimeopsi myeongnyohage pyohyeonhamnida.

c362.x: 간결한 설명이 장황한 연설보다 훨씬 명확합니다.
c362.xr: Gangyeolhan seolmyeongi janghwanghan yeonseolboda hwolssin myeonghwakamnida.

c364.x: 생생한 실제 사례는 주장을 훨씬 더 설득력 있게 만듭니다.
c364.xr: Saengsaenghan silje saryeneun jujangeul hwolssin deo seoldeungnyeok itge mandeumnida.

c365.x: 우리는 단계적 도입을 위한 실용적인 로드맵을 채택했습니다.
c365.xr: Urineun dangyejeok doibeul wihan siryongjeogin rodeumaebeul chaetaekaesseumnida.

c366.x: 천문대는 전례 없는 선명도의 우주 영상을 포착했습니다.
c366.xr: Cheonmundaeneun jeollye eomneun seonmyeongdoui uju yeongsangeul pochakaesseumnida.

c368.x: 깊은 유창함을 위해서는 적극적인 경청이 필수 불가결합니다.
c368.xr: Gipeun yuchanghameul wihaeseoneun jeokgeukjeogin gyeongcheongi pilsu bulgagyeolhamnida.

c370.x: 우리의 목표는 모든 기기에서 매끄러운 경험을 제공하는 것입니다.
c370.xr: Uriui mokpyoneun modeun gigieseo maekkeureoun gyeongheomeul jegonghaneun geosimnida.

c371.x: 의심의 여지 없이 꾸준함이 결국 승리를 이끕니다.
c371.xr: Uisimui yeoji eopsi kkujunhami gyeolguk seungnireul ikkeumnida.

c372.x: 우리는 속도를 중시합니다. 마찬가지로 품질도 결코 타협하지 않습니다.
c372.xr: Urineun sokdoreul jungsihamnida. Machangajiro pumjildo gyeolko tahyeopaji anseumnida.

c373.x: 모든 점을 종합해 보면 올해는 우리에게 최고의 한 해였습니다.
c373.xr: Modeun jeomeul jonghapae bomyeon olhaeneun uriege choegoui han haeyeosseumnida.

c374.x: 정성을 들여 쌓아 올린 열린 지식은 세월의 시험을 견뎌 냅니다.
c374.xr: Jeongseongeul deuryeo ssaa ollin yeollin jisigeun seworui siheomeul gyeondyeo naemnida.

c375.x: 언어를 익히는 일은 평생 학습이라는 즐거운 모험입니다.
c375.xr: Eoneoreul ikineun ireun pyeongsaeng hakseubiraneun jeulgeoun moheomimnida.
